description: List what the user can buy: Starter (unlock one theme), Pro, Agency (monthly or yearly) and pay-as-you-go credit packs, with what each includes and today's price. Pass jobId to see options for unlocking that conversion. Show all options to the user and let them choose; do not pick for them. Then call wpconvert_checkout with the checkout_arguments of their choice.
name: wpconvert_plans
